correctness.rationale: For every positive synchronous pair, strict two-step running-max decay forces u_n to zero. The exact two-step ratio recurrence is eventually a projective contraction with limit ratio one. The fifth-order polynomial f(t)=t-t^3/3+t^5/9 has a seventh-order invariance defect; the normalized lag error is contracting, giving u_{n+1}=f(u_n)+O(u_n^7). Exact arithmetic confirms -1/27 for the defect and 2/3, 1/9 for the inverse-square increment. The 1/(6n) term has summable remainder, proving a finite residual and both amplitudes. Four finite numerical checks agree but are not infinite proofs.
